svg.title: AI Collaboration Summary — All time
svg.desc: 1163 AI-attributed commits, 1182 AI actor presences across 92 active AI days (author dates), 2 AI providers. Daily activity calendar 2026-05-08 to 2026-07-30, peak day summed provider-attributed count 120; provider counts may overlap. Generated 2026-07-30.
